rules.name: Storage accounts must require HTTPS
rules.kql: Resources | where subscriptionId == '{subscriptionId}' | where type == 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, properties

rules.name: Virtual machines should have Environment tag
rules.kql: Resources | where subscriptionId == '{subscriptionId}' | where type == 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines' | project id, name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, properties, tags

rules.name: Key Vault soft delete enabled
rules.description: enableSoftDelete should be true where applicable
rules.kql: Resources | where subscriptionId == '{subscriptionId}' | where type == 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' | project id, name, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, properties
